episodes.title: The Witching Hour
episodes.summary: Neurosurgeon Rowan Fielding has a problem -- when she gets mad, she kills with her mind; her search for answers sends her toward her secretive biological family; in New Orleans, Deirdre Mayfair is desperate to escape from her aunt's oppressive house.

episodes.title: The Dark Place
episodes.summary: Wracked with grief over Ellie's death, Rowan is out of control and unfit to perform surgeries; her paranoia that someone is following her is proven true; in New Orleans, Deirdre and her mysterious companion Lasher work together to draw Rowan home.

episodes.title: Second Line
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of Deirdre's grisly death, Rowan searches for safety in a strange city; Sip provides Rowan with a safe house while he investigates Deirdre's murder; Lasher makes contact with Rowan but not in the way one might expect.

episodes.title: Curiouser and Curiouser
episodes.summary: At Deirdre's funeral, Rowan is plunged into the world of the infamous Mayfair family; Uncle Cortland and Aunt Carlotta present diverging views on Lasher; Rowan must choose whom to trust and face the dire consequences; Sip identifies Deirdre's killer.

episodes.title: The Thrall
episodes.summary: Trapped in the First Street House, Rowan and Sip must confront its many mysteries in order to escape; Rowan grapples with an inconceivable offer; Sip's sister Odette makes a horrifying discovery.

episodes.title: Transference
episodes.summary: Desperate to relinquish Lasher, Rowan reaches out to her extended Mayfair family for help; Rowan must trust their unique process, a sacred ritual; Sip's search for answers takes him back to the Talamasca.

episodes.title: Tessa
episodes.summary: Rowan makes a shocking discovery but has to deal with it alone; a tragic event brings Rowan closer to the Mayfairs and Lasher. Sip falls deeper down the rabbit hole of the key necklace.

episodes.title: What Rough Beast
episodes.summary: Rowan inadvertently discovers her role in a prophecy that's held the Mayfair family for generations; Sip's investigation reaches its conclusion, uncovering secrets that could tarnish both Rowan's family and his role in the Talamasca.

episodes.title: Lasher
episodes.summary: Rowan Mayfair is determined to understand what Lasher has become; Sip is hell-bent on capturing him.

episodes.title: Ten of Swords
episodes.summary: Rowan must find Lasher before more people are hurt; Sip finds an ally in an angry Mayfair cousin.

episodes.title: Cover the Mirrors
episodes.summary: Rowan desperately partners with Cortland to try to stop Lasher; Moira assists Sip in capturing him.

episodes.title: Double Helix
episodes.summary: Rowan must find Lasher in order to right her wrongs, but even Sip doesn't know where Lasher is.

episodes.title: Julien's Victrola
episodes.summary: Rowan demands Julien's help in finding Lasher; Moira probes Cortland's mind for important memories.

episodes.title: Michaelmas
episodes.summary: Rowan, Moira, Cortland, and Lark search for Lasher in Scotland; Sip is questioned by the Talamasca.

episodes.title: A Tangled Web
episodes.summary: Rowan seeks Lasher, who joined the Scottish Mayfairs; Sip reluctantly assists the Talamasca.

episodes.title: The Innocents
episodes.summary: Rowan is determined to save Lasher; Cortland becomes an unlikely adversary.
